source_contract: Canonical repository rules are projected; this registry does not invent truth or authority.

rules.human_label: 工程完成不等于外部真值
rules.antecedent: A repository implementation, validator, CI run or bounded pilot reaches its declared local completion state.
rules.candidate_transition: The local record may transition to a repository-scoped engineering completion state.
forbidden_inference: Do not infer external truth, production safety or universal validity.
required_gate_or_evidence: Use the declared repository validator and retain its scope and residuals.
rules.allowed_weaker_conclusion: The bounded implementation or fixture passed the named repository checks.
rules.unknown_retention_rule: If external evidence is absent, external truth remains unknown rather than false or true.
rules.withdrawal_rebound_semantics: A later local repair does not silently revive a withdrawn external claim.

rules.human_label: 写作或出版完成不等于真值成立
rules.antecedent: A report, Results Book entry or public-safe explanation has passed its publication and privacy gates.
rules.candidate_transition: The material may become a bounded public projection with its claim ceiling preserved.
forbidden_inference: Do not infer that publication proves the represented proposition.
required_gate_or_evidence: Preserve source, provenance, privacy, disposition and claim ceiling.
rules.allowed_weaker_conclusion: The text is a public-safe, source-bounded representation of a recorded result or open question.
rules.unknown_retention_rule: Unresolved truth and replication remain unknown after publication.
rules.withdrawal_rebound_semantics: A revised publication must retain append-only lineage and cannot erase the withdrawn version.

rules.human_label: 模型或 Agent 共识不产生 authority
rules.antecedent: One or more models, Agents, reviewers or executors produce matching judgments or receipts.
rules.candidate_transition: The record may note agreement as bounded observation or review evidence.
forbidden_inference: Do not convert agreement into Owner authority, truth or permission.
required_gate_or_evidence: Bind each judgment to its role, source, scope and independent validation path.
rules.allowed_weaker_conclusion: The named participants agreed within the recorded task and evidence boundary.
rules.unknown_retention_rule: Whether the agreed proposition is true or externally valid remains unresolved without its own evidence.
rules.withdrawal_rebound_semantics: Repeated agreement cannot rebound a withdrawn or quarantined claim.

rules.antecedent: A mathematical maturity, formalization or engineering-quality observation changes on one axis.
rules.candidate_transition: Only the named axis and its evidence-bound record may change.
forbidden_inference: Do not infer an automatic M-to-E or E-to-M upgrade.
required_gate_or_evidence: Use the independent axis gate and preserve the other axis as recorded.
rules.allowed_weaker_conclusion: The specified maturity or evidence dimension has the recorded local status.
rules.unknown_retention_rule: The unaltered axis remains at its prior or unknown status.
rules.withdrawal_rebound_semantics: Withdrawal on one axis does not disappear because another axis improves.

rules.antecedent: The evidence packet, provenance or gate does not license a stronger conclusion.
rules.candidate_transition: The record may retain UNKNOWN, conditional or pending status.
forbidden_inference: Do not fill an evidence gap with a plausible story, consensus or formatting cue.
required_gate_or_evidence: Name the missing evidence or authority required for a future transition.
rules.allowed_weaker_conclusion: The proposition is unresolved within the specified scope and evidence boundary.
rules.unknown_retention_rule: Unknown is a valid terminal or holding state until new qualifying evidence arrives.
rules.withdrawal_rebound_semantics: A change of label or context does not turn unknown into established.

rules.human_label: 撤回或隔离不得改名回弹
rules.antecedent: A claim or result is withdrawn, quarantined, downgraded or marked historical.
rules.candidate_transition: It remains in append-only lineage with the restrictive disposition.
forbidden_inference: Do not revive it by changing its title, identifier, wording or projection surface.
required_gate_or_evidence: Require a governed successor with new provenance and independently reviewed evidence.
rules.allowed_weaker_conclusion: The older record is historical or withdrawn and may explain why it is not currently usable.
rules.unknown_retention_rule: The successor remains unknown or bounded until its own gates pass.
rules.withdrawal_rebound_semantics: Rebound is forbidden without an explicit successor lineage and fresh evidence.

rules.human_label: Owner authority 不能由 Agent 自赋
rules.antecedent: An Agent, model, receipt or local workflow proposes an Owner-level acceptance or permission decision.
rules.candidate_transition: The proposal may be recorded for Owner review without changing Owner state.
forbidden_inference: Do not self-assign Owner acceptance, Owner authority or an Owner gate result.
required_gate_or_evidence: Require the explicit Owner-controlled gate and its auditable record.
rules.allowed_weaker_conclusion: A bounded proposal or review packet is ready for the authorized Owner decision.
rules.unknown_retention_rule: Owner acceptance remains pending when the Owner gate is absent.
rules.withdrawal_rebound_semantics: A prior Owner decision cannot be recreated by repeating an Agent proposal.

rules.human_label: 证据级别不能自动越级
rules.antecedent: A source, fixture, review or observation supports a conclusion at a bounded evidence level.
rules.candidate_transition: The conclusion may be stated only up to the licensed level and scope.
forbidden_inference: Do not widen scope, quantifier, causal force or generality without a new gate.
required_gate_or_evidence: Use the claim ceiling, provenance and relevant adjudication or replication requirement.
rules.allowed_weaker_conclusion: The source supports the strongest explicitly licensed conclusion and no more.
rules.unknown_retention_rule: The next stronger claim remains unknown or pending its named obligation.
rules.withdrawal_rebound_semantics: A stronger historical wording cannot return through a weaker-looking label.

rules.human_label: runtime 成功不等于 epistemic acceptance
rules.antecedent: A local runtime, executor adapter, pilot, receipt or recovery path reaches a terminal success state.
rules.candidate_transition: The local operational record may transition to its declared bounded completion status.
forbidden_inference: Do not set EPISTEMICALLY_ACCEPTED or claim external success from the runtime state.
required_gate_or_evidence: Preserve the explicit runtime claim ceiling and separate epistemic/Owner gates.
rules.allowed_weaker_conclusion: The named local run or contract completed under its bounded conditions.
rules.unknown_retention_rule: Epistemic acceptance remains 0 and external validity remains unresolved.
rules.withdrawal_rebound_semantics: A successful later run does not erase a failed or residual earlier run.

rules.human_label: local fixture 不等于 production 或 generalization
rules.antecedent: A disposable fixture or offline pilot produces a reproducible observation.
rules.candidate_transition: The fixture may support a repository-scoped compatibility or coordination statement.
forbidden_inference: Do not generalize the result to production, all models, all providers or the external world.
required_gate_or_evidence: Name the fixture, environment, provider status and untested dimensions.
rules.allowed_weaker_conclusion: The behavior was observed in the specified disposable local fixture.
rules.unknown_retention_rule: Production behavior and cross-environment transfer remain unknown.
rules.withdrawal_rebound_semantics: A fixture rerun does not repair an untested generalization claim.

rules.human_label: 来源或 provenance 缺失时降级
rules.antecedent: A proposed claim, observation or publication lacks recoverable source, rights or provenance binding.
rules.candidate_transition: The item may remain private, pending, non-republished or bounded as an observation.
forbidden_inference: Do not treat a summary, path, hash or confidence score as a substitute for missing source bytes.
required_gate_or_evidence: Recover the required source and rights binding or preserve the restrictive disposition.
rules.allowed_weaker_conclusion: A source-bounded note records that the material could not yet be admitted at a stronger level.
rules.unknown_retention_rule: The unsupported proposition remains unknown and cannot enter a stronger public claim path.
rules.withdrawal_rebound_semantics: A new projection of the same unbound material does not restore provenance.

rules.antecedent: Task, profile, pack, executor and approval scopes are composed for a proposed action.
rules.candidate_transition: The effective capability is the validated intersection of declared scopes.
forbidden_inference: Do not widen permission because a model is cautious, a surface was read or an ESI score is high.
required_gate_or_evidence: Use the canonical policy/permission intersection and explicit approval contract.
rules.allowed_weaker_conclusion: The action is permitted only within the smallest declared intersection, or is denied.
rules.unknown_retention_rule: An unproven capability or permission remains unavailable rather than implicitly granted.
rules.withdrawal_rebound_semantics: A revoked or expired capability cannot rebound from a soft observation.
